title: Issaraṃ
text: Kiṃsu issariyaṃ loke || kiṃsu bhaṇḍānam uttamaṃ || kiṃsu satthamalaṃ loke || kiṃsu lokasmim abbudaṃ || || kiṃsu harantaṃ vārenti || haranto pana ko piyo || kiṃsu punappanāyantaṃ || abhinandanti paṇḍitāti || || Vaso issariyaṃ loke || itthi bhaṇḍānam uttamaṃ || kodho satthamalam loke || corā lokasmim abbudā || || coram harantaṃ vārenti || haranto samaṇo piyo || samaṇam punappunāyantaṃ || abhinandanti paṇḍitāti || || [page 044] 44 DEVATĀ-SAṂYUTTA I. [I. 8. 8.
